svg.title: Faiyh Assault Craft - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Small Craft Catalogue (2023), printed 88-89, PDF 89-90. Combined plan envelope retains slender rounded forward body, crescent-like rear aerofoils and protruding central aft drive. Smaller troop deck is contained within main deck projection. Illustration supports broad swept rear wings. Vertical surface detail and detached weapon symbols excluded.
